question: For tree planting in Canadian forest restoration, how do planting-stock traits (seedling size, nursery fertilization, mycorrhizal inoculation) affect survival and growth, and how do competing vegetation and site preparation change that?

cause.label: Tree planting stock traits and site preparation

edges.sentence: Survival was highest for trees planted 10 m away from the cliff edge in undisturbed locations (treatment 8); 95% of these trees survived the first year, and 85% were alive at the end of the study (Fig. 3a).
